## get

Get Kb Health. `GET /kb-health`

Knowledge-base health dashboard.

Buckets: most used, never used, flagged, low quality, possible duplicates, stale. Note never_used counts *sent replies*, not retrievals — an entry that keeps getting retrieved but never makes it into an answer is exactly the kind of dead weight this view exists to surface.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbHealth()->get();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$folderId` | `?string` | no | Restrict to one KB folder |
